level.title: Mandarin A1+ — Practical exchanges, repair and simple choices
goals: Ask for and confirm travel information.
Make purchases and clarify quantities politely.

lessons.title: Ask when a train leaves
lessons.learn: Ask for a departure time and confirm the platform.

grammar.title: question with 几点
grammar.explain: Place the time question before the verb 出发.

examples.r: qǐng wèn，zhè tàng chē jǐ diǎn chū fā？
examples.en: May I ask what time this train leaves?

examples.r: tā xià wǔ sān diǎn chū fā。
examples.en: It leaves at three in the afternoon.

examples.r: qǐng zài shuō yí biàn zhàn tái hào mǎ。
examples.en: Please say the platform number once more.

mistakes.why: Put 几点 before the verb in this neutral question.

lessons.title: Buy a one-way ticket
lessons.learn: Request a ticket and ask about the fare.

grammar.title: measure word 张
grammar.explain: 张 is the measure word for a ticket or other flat item.

examples.t: 我要一张去上海的单程票。
examples.r: wǒ yào yì zhāng qù shàng hǎi de dān chéng piào。
examples.en: I would like a one-way ticket to Shanghai.

examples.r: qǐng wèn piào jià shì duō shǎo？
examples.en: May I ask what the fare is?

examples.r: wǒ kě yǐ yòng xiàn jīn fù kuǎn ma？
examples.en: Can I pay in cash?

mistakes.why: Use 张, not 个, as the measure word for a ticket.

lessons.title: Repair a missed announcement
lessons.learn: Say that you missed information and request a slower repetition.

grammar.title: polite repair
grammar.explain: State what you did not hear, then make one clear request.

examples.r: wǒ gāng cái méi tīng qīng chǔ。
examples.en: I did not hear clearly just now.

examples.r: nín néng shuō màn yì diǎn ma？
examples.en: Could you speak a little more slowly?

examples.t: 我把站台号码记下来了。
examples.r: wǒ bǎ zhàn tái hào mǎ jì xià lái le。
examples.en: I wrote down the platform number.

mistakes.why: Place the time phrase before the verb and 没 before the verb.

lessons.title: Ask the price
lessons.learn: Ask how much an item costs and confirm the quantity.

grammar.title: price question
grammar.explain: Use 多少钱 to ask for a price; add a measure word when giving quantity.

examples.r: qǐng wèn，zhè xiē píng guǒ duō shǎo qián？
examples.en: May I ask how much these apples cost?

examples.r: yì jīn shí èr kuài。
examples.en: Twelve yuan for half a kilogram.

examples.r: wǒ xiān mǎi liǎng jīn。
examples.en: I will buy one kilogram first.

mistakes.why: 多少钱 is the natural price question here.

lessons.title: Choose ripe fruit
lessons.learn: Ask for ripe fruit and explain a preference politely.

grammar.title: 想要 + object
grammar.explain: Use 想要 to state a preference and 不要 for a polite negative request.

examples.r: wǒ xiǎng yào shú yì diǎn de táo zi。
examples.en: I would like peaches that are a little riper.

examples.t: 请给我大的，不要太软的。
examples.r: qǐng gěi wǒ dà de，bú yào tài ruǎn de。
examples.en: Please give me the larger ones, not ones that are too soft.

examples.r: zhè ge kàn qǐ lái hěn xīn xiān。
examples.en: This one looks very fresh.

mistakes.why: Use 一点的 to make the comparison natural.

quiz.q: Which meaning best fits 有空?
quiz.why: 有空 (yǒu kòng) means to be free in this lesson.

quiz.q: Which meaning best fits 见面?
quiz.why: 见面 (jiàn miàn) means to meet in this lesson.

quiz.q: Which meaning best fits 先?
quiz.why: 先 (xiān) means first in this lesson.

culture.text: Chinese characters are not an alphabet: many characters represent a syllable and a meaning-bearing unit, and words may use one or several characters. Measure words such as 个 and 本 are part of ordinary counting patterns. The note describes writing, not a single cultural identity. At this bridge rung, short exchanges include one repair move: asking for repetition, checking a price or confirming a plan. Pinyin here is a reading aid; standard written Chinese does not put spaces between every character.

reading.text: 我叫林。今天我在学校学习中文。老师写了三个新字，我先看笔画，再读拼音。下课以后，我把生词记在本子上。 旅客问了两次站台号码。售票员说得慢了一点，旅客把号码写在车票旁边。
reading.gloss: My name is Lin. Today I study Chinese at school. The teacher writes three new characters. I first look at the strokes, then read the pinyin. After class, I write the new words in my notebook. The traveller asked for the platform number twice. The clerk spoke a little more slowly, and the traveller wrote the number beside the ticket.

listening.script:
老师：请问，你叫什么名字？
学生：我叫林。
老师：你今天学了什么？
学生：我学了三个新字。
旅客：这趟车在几号站台？
工作人员：在三号站台。
旅客：谢谢，我写下来了。
listening.gloss: Teacher: May I ask your name? Student: My name is Lin. Teacher: What did you learn today? Student: I learned three new characters. Traveller: Which platform is this train on? Staff member: Platform three. Traveller: Thank you; I have written it down.

mistakes.why: 叫 already introduces a name; do not add 是.
A question word already marks the question; do not add 吗.
Use 本 as the measure word for a book.
